policies.text: Institutional trading approval is granted to an entity with primary solvency clearance that maintains a regulatory risk score of at least 80 points.
Tier-one commercial status is conferred upon an entity securing high-revenue designation.
Prime brokerage access is extended to any client with corporate syndicate clearance.
Expedited underwriting clearance requires tier-one commercial status together with an operational risk rating of at least 70 points.
Primary solvency clearance is granted to an applicant that achieves capital reserve qualification.
Overseas market participation is awarded to a candidate with international account permission that employs at least 10 certified compliance officers.
A wholesale currency desk obtains automated routing capability when daily transactional volume exceeds 50,000,000 EUR.

Comprehensive governance certification is granted when an entity with yearly turnover of 10,000,000 USD or more holds institutional tier 1 status and conducts at least 4 AML compliance audits per year.
Short-term solvency clearance is achieved when an enterprise maintains an emergency liquidity reserve of at least 400,000 USD.
High-revenue designation is attained when yearly turnover reaches at least 10,000,000 USD.
An applicant achieves capital reserve qualification when paid-in equity reaches at least 4,000,000 USD.
International account permission is granted to a candidate holding cross-border authorization.
Accreditation as a fund manager is granted when managed assets equal or exceed 5,000,000 USD.
Corporate account authorization is extended to an enterprise with baseline onboarding clearance that holds a liquid cash reserve of at least 1,500,000 USD.
Cross-border authorization is conferred when an enterprise holds an international brokerage licence.
A custodian entity receives depository recognition when maintaining pledged collateral of at least 15,000,000 GBP.
Corporate syndicate clearance is granted to a firm with comprehensive governance certification that maintains a corporate guarantee of at least 8,000,000 USD.

Verification credibility status is established if a firm generates turnover of at least 10,000,000 USD per year, holds a commercial banking charter, or maintains an international credit rating of at least 75 points.
Priority processing approval is awarded to any firm holding verification credibility status.

Baseline onboarding clearance requires an enterprise to satisfy at least one condition: maintaining paid-in equity of 4,000,000 USD or higher, holding an international brokerage licence, or maintaining an ISO 27001 security certification.
